$Comment: Leyline, the Arcane Focus's signature: an Arcane hit (where the Arcane damage line counts) slows its foe to half speed for 2 seconds (the game's Slow, a Slow to a boss's rules, so a boss or an elite shrugs it), each foe at most once every 10 seconds. Its slow waits per foe like every slow: an Immune foe is passed over, it is shorter each time on a foe slowed again soon, and each landing ramps the foe's Immunity. Opens on the Signature step while the Arcane Focus is sworn. Retune or switch it off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/procs.json.
